description:
Real estate transfer taxes on a sale, from the statutes and tax offices, free. `place`: nyc (all five
        boroughs), ny (New York State outside NYC), fl (Florida outside Miami-Dade), philadelphia, chicago, cook (Cook
        County outside Chicago), nc, sc, ar, tx or az (state or city names work too). `price`: the consideration in
        dollars. `kind`: residential or other (NYC rates differ). `mortgage`: Florida only, the new mortgage amount
        (adds note stamps and the intangible tax).

        Returns each tax with its amount and who customarily pays (seller, buyer, negotiable), the total, flags for
        what is not included (NYC supplemental tax, local municipal taxes), and the sources. An estimate, not tax advice.
name: transfer_tax
